attested_training(p_dept uuid, p_from ti.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attested_training(p_dept uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, session_id uuid, start_at timestamp with time zone, end_at timestamp with time zone, optional boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with drill as (
    select
      ts.id,
      ts.department_id,
      -- wall clock -> instant, in the department's zone. See the header.
      (ts.date + coalesce(ts.start_time, '00:00'::time)) at time zone 'America/Chicago' as start_at,
      -- flat 90 minutes, never more than the drill itself ran
      least(interval '90 minutes', make_interval(mins => ts.duration_min))               as credited_len,
      (coalesce(ts.counts_toward_attendance, true) = false)                              as optional
    from public.training_sessions ts
    where ts.department_id = p_dept
      and ts.done                                     -- a drill that has not happened has no hours
      and ts.duration_min is not null                 -- no recorded length, no estimate
      and coalesce(ts.audience, 'everyone') <> 'board' -- a board meeting is not training
      and coalesce(ts.is_offsite, false) = false      -- off-site stays out of station hours
  )
  select
    sa.member_id,
    d.id                       as session_id,
    d.start_at,
    d.start_at + d.credited_len as end_at,
    d.optional
  from drill d
  join public.session_attendance sa on sa.session_id = d.id
  -- LOOSE PREFILTER, on purpose. This is an OVERLAP test, not a containment test:
  -- dept_station_shifts wants drills that START inside the window, while dept_iso_hours
  -- wants any interval that TOUCHES it so a straddling drill can be clipped rather than
  -- dropped. Narrowing this to start_at >= p_from would silently rob the ISO caller of
  -- exactly those rows, so the wider test lives here and each caller narrows its own way.
  and d.start_at < p_to
  and d.start_at + d.credited_len > p_from
  -- OBSERVED WINS. A member who actually checked in has a real interval; the attestation
  -- is not emitted for them at all, which is what stops the same drill being counted twice.
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.station_presence sp
     where sp.kind = 'training'
       and sp.session_id = sa.session_id
       and sp.member_id  = sa.member_id
  );
$function$

dept_iso_hours_for(p_dept uuid, p_from t.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_iso_hours_for(p_dept uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, training_hours numeric, standby_hours numeric, iso_total_hours numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
-- WS-4d D-2 (2026-10-28): a business meeting's time (is_meeting) credits STANDBY, not training — decided at read time; totals unchanged.
begin
  if p_dept is null then raise exception 'A department is required.'; end if;
  if p_from is null or p_to is null then raise exception 'A start and end date are both required.'; end if;
  if p_from >= p_to then raise exception 'The start of the period must come before the end.'; end if;
  return query
  with clipped as (
    select sp.member_id as mid, (sp.kind = 'training' and not coalesce((select t.is_meeting from public.training_sessions t where t.id = sp.session_id), false)) as is_training,
      tstzrange(greatest(sp.checked_in_at, p_from), least(sp.checked_out_at, p_to), '[)') as span
    from public.station_presence sp
    where sp.department_id = p_dept and sp.verified and sp.checked_out_at is not null
      and not sp.auto_closed and sp.kind in ('standby','training')
      and sp.checked_in_at < p_to and sp.checked_out_at > p_from
    union all
    select att.member_id as mid, not coalesce((select t.is_meeting from public.training_sessions t where t.id = att.session_id), false) as is_training,
      tstzrange(greatest(att.start_at, p_from), least(att.end_at, p_to), '[)') as span
    from public.attested_training(p_dept, p_from, p_to) att
    where not att.optional and att.start_at < p_to and att.end_at > p_from
  ),
  live as (select * from clipped where not isempty(span)),
  agg as (
    select c.mid,
      range_agg(c.span) filter (where c.is_training) as training_mr,
      range_agg(c.span) as all_mr
    from live c group by c.mid
  ),
  secs as (
    select a.mid,
      coalesce((select sum(extract(epoch from (upper(r) - lower(r)))) from unnest(a.training_mr) r), 0) as training_secs,
      coalesce((select sum(extract(epoch from (upper(r) - lower(r)))) from unnest(a.all_mr) r), 0) as total_secs
    from agg a
  ),
  final as (
    select s.mid as mid, m.name as mname,
      round((s.training_secs / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as t_hours,
      round(((s.total_secs - s.training_secs) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as s_hours,
      round((s.total_secs / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as tot_hours
    from secs s join public.members m on m.id = s.mid
  )
  select f.mid, f.mname, f.t_hours, f.s_hours, f.tot_hours from final f
  order by f.tot_hours desc, f.mname;
end;
$function$

is_dept_admin().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_dept_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.members
    where lower(members.email) = lower(auth.email())
      and members.status in ('Active','Probationary')
      and members.department_id = public.my_department_id()
      and members.access && array['Project Admin','Department Admin']::text[]
  );
$function$

is_leader().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_leader()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from members
    where lower(members.email) = lower(auth.email())
      and members.status in ('Active','Probationary')
      and members.department_id = public.my_department_id()
      and members.access && array['Project Admin','Department Admin','Board Member','Officer']::text[]
  );
$function$

is_training_manager().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_training_manager()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  -- B4C:training officers — THE training-management gate: a Department Admin in the caller's department (not Project Admin —
  -- deliberately not is_dept_admin()) OR an active training officer there. Schedules / edits / completes / reopens sessions
  -- (meetings and board events included), marks the roster, manages categories and the drill-plan library.
    select exists (
      select 1 from public.members m
       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
         and m.department_id = public.my_department_id()
         and m.access && array['Department Admin']::text[]
    ) or public.is_training_officer();
  $function$

is_training_officer().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_training_officer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  -- B4C:training officers — an ACTIVE registry row for the caller's member row in the caller's department. Department-scoped
  -- (unlike is_equipment_manager()): an officer of one department is not one in another.
    select exists (
      select 1 from public.training_officer t
       where t.member_id = public.my_member_id()
         and t.department_id = public.my_department_id()
         and t.removed_at is null
    );
  $function$

my_department_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_department_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    -- 1) the saved active station, ONLY if it's still one of the caller's departments
    ( select mad.department_id
        from public.member_active_department mad
       where mad.email = lower(auth.email())
         and exists ( select 1 from public.members m
                       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
                         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
                         and m.department_id = mad.department_id ) ),
    -- 2) else their department, deterministically. Single-dept = byte-identical to the old body.
    ( select m.department_id
        from public.members m
       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
       order by m.department_id
       limit 1 )
  );
$function$

my_member_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_member_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select id
  from public.members
  where lower(email) = lower(auth.email())
    and status in ('Active','Probationary')
    and department_id = public.my_department_id()
  limit 1;
$function$

recompute_training_plan_last_iso(p_plan_.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_training_plan_last_iso(p_plan_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    -- B4C:slice6 R4 — a category's "last trained" = the latest FINALIZED drill in it with a NON-EMPTY roll. Called by the
    -- correction / reopen RPCs so a corrected date, category or roll can't leave it stale. No such drill -> left as is
    -- (never nulled: a value set before the app tracked sessions has no evidence to replace it with).
    begin
      if p_plan_id is null then return; end if;
      update public.training_plans tp
         set last_iso = coalesce((select max(ts."date") from public.training_sessions ts
                                   where ts.plan_id = tp.id and ts.done
                                     and exists (select 1 from public.session_attendance sa where sa.session_id = ts.id)),
                                 tp.last_iso)
       where tp.id = p_plan_id;
    end;
    $function$

session_reaction_tally(p_session_ids uui.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.session_reaction_tally(p_session_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(session_id uuid, up integer, down integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    -- B4C:E1E3 slice R — leadership's view of the reactions: COUNTS ONLY, never who. is_leader() (PA / DA / Board / Officer in
    -- the caller's active department). Counts only votes from members STILL on the session's roll (someone removed via Correct
    -- drops out), only sessions in the caller's department (any other id returns nothing), and a session returns NO row until
    -- it has at least 3 counted votes — so a small session can't be de-anonymised. Enforced here, so the API can't bypass it.
    declare v_dept uuid := public.my_department_id();
    begin
      if v_dept is null or not public.is_leader() then
        raise exception 'NOT_ALLOWED: only department leadership can see reaction tallies.';
      end if;
      return query
        select r.session_id,
               (count(*) filter (where r.value = 1))::integer,
               (count(*) filter (where r.value = -1))::integer
          from public.training_session_reactions r
          join public.training_sessions ts on ts.id = r.session_id and ts.department_id = v_dept
         where r.session_id = any (p_session_ids)
           and r.department_id = v_dept
           and exists (select 1 from public.session_attendance a where a.session_id = r.session_id and a.member_id = r.member_id)
         group by r.session_id
        having count(*) >= 3;
    end;
$function$

tg_training_session_lock_guard().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_training_session_lock_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    -- B4C:slice6 C7 — once a session is FINALIZED or HAS ATTENDANCE (Slice 7: or is CANCELLED), the fields that define the
    -- record (and the attested hours derived from it) change only through the RPCs, which set the transaction-local flag.
    -- Exempt so Finalize / sign-in keep working: done, signin_open, signin_token, location_lat/lng/radius_m,
    -- location_label, and duration_min NULL -> a value on a not-yet-finalized row (Finalize's length prompt).
    -- Slice 7: status ('scheduled'/'cancelled') changes ONLY under the flag (approve_session_change), on any row, and a new
    -- row is always 'scheduled'. date / start_time stay free on an upcoming, unattended session (plain Edit — ruling 3b).
    -- Applies to EVERY writer, the table owner included — a hand fix in the SQL editor must set the flag on purpose.
    -- B4C:E1E3 slice T — actual_start / actual_end / setup_min follow duration_min's rule: set once on a not-yet-finalized row
    -- (Finalize), Correct-only after.
    begin
      if coalesce(current_setting('b4c.session_correction', true), '') = 'on' then return NEW; end if;
      if TG_OP = 'INSERT' then
        if NEW.status is distinct from 'scheduled' then
          raise exception 'STATUS_LOCKED: a session is created scheduled — cancelling takes the two-person sign-off.' using errcode = '42501';
        end if;
        return NEW;
      end if;
      if NEW.status is distinct from OLD.status then
        raise exception 'STATUS_LOCKED: a session is cancelled or restored only through the two-person sign-off.' using errcode = '42501';
      end if;
      if not (OLD.done is true or OLD.status = 'cancelled' or exists (select 1 from public.session_attendance sa where sa.session_id = OLD.id)) then
        return NEW;
      end if;
      if NEW.title is distinct from OLD.title
         or NEW."date" is distinct from OLD."date"
         or NEW.start_time is distinct from OLD.start_time
         or NEW.audience is distinct from OLD.audience
         or NEW.plan_id is distinct from OLD.plan_id
         or NEW.counts_toward_attendance is distinct from OLD.counts_toward_attendance
         or NEW.is_meeting is distinct from OLD.is_meeting
         or NEW.is_offsite is distinct from OLD.is_offsite
         or NEW.department_id is distinct from OLD.department_id
         or NEW.series_id is distinct from OLD.series_id
         or (NEW.duration_min is distinct from OLD.duration_min
             and not (OLD.duration_min is null and OLD.done is not true))
         or (NEW.actual_start is distinct from OLD.actual_start
             and not (OLD.actual_start is null and OLD.done is not true))
         or (NEW.actual_end is distinct from OLD.actual_end
             and not (OLD.actual_end is null and OLD.done is not true))
         or (NEW.setup_min is distinct from OLD.setup_min
             and not (OLD.setup_min is null and OLD.done is not true)) then
        raise exception 'LOCKED_SESSION: this session is finalized, cancelled or has attendance — change it with Correct (or Restore), which is logged.'
          using errcode = '42501';
      end if;
      return NEW;
    end;
    $function$
